title: Inhibition of METTL3 Results in a Cell-Intrinsic Interferon Response That Enhances Antitumor Immunity
model: B16-Ova-Cas9 mouse melanoma co-cultured with OT-I T cells, Brie genome-wide library
contrast: Mettl3 inhibitor (STM2457) vs DMSO in OT-I co-culture, blocked by E:T ratio (4 vs 3 libraries, one per condition)
paper_calls: Abstract names dsRNA sensing and interferon signalling as mediators
barcs_calls: 4 genes at FDR 0.10 (6 against the control null)
named_hits: 3/6 recovered (Jak1, Stat1, Ifngr1; not Ifih1, Mavs, Ifnar1)
verdict: BARCS finds interferon-gamma signalling (Jak1, Stat1, Ifngr1, Ifngr2) as the only genes whose loss protects B16 cells from T-cell killing specifically under Mettl3 inhibition, supporting the paper's interferon-signalling claim, but finds no enrichment for the dsRNA sensors Ifih1 and Mavs or for Ifnar1.
